content: Good morning, this is Officer Daniel Brooks from the IRS Criminal Investigation Division. My badge number is CI-47952. Am I speaking with Mr. Patel?
Yes, this is Patel. Is there a problem?
Sir, the reason for my call is regarding discrepancies in your recent tax filings, specifically unreported cryptocurrency transactions. The IRS has flagged your account for 2022 and 2023.
I am sorry, I do not understand. I filed my taxes with an accountant. What is wrong with my taxes?
Our records show multiple digital asset transfers that were not reported. This is a direct violation of U.S. tax code. I must inform you that tax evasion is a serious federal offense.
I did not know. I just bought some crypto, but I thought that was legal. What do I need to do?

You should have declared all cryptocurrency purchases and sales. Unfortunately, your case has been assigned a federal case number: TXC-2814. If you fail to comply, the IRS may issue a warrant for your arrest.
Please, I do not want any trouble. How can I fix this? I do not want to be arrested.
Because this is your first violation, you are eligible for a one-time compliance settlement. Paying the settlement fee today will prevent further legal action, but you must act immediately.
What is the settlement fee? Can I pay online?

For your case, the fee totals $3,600. To process this efficiently, it must be paid via cryptocurrency, as this is the asset in question. I will provide you with the IRS's secure digital wallet address.
I am not sure how to do this. I have some Bitcoin in my Coinbase. Can I send from there?
Yes, you can use Coinbase. I will give you the wallet address now: 1KxS7w3u9zLmT5aXQYp9ErV6AbdJ8PzQrT. Once you send the payment, provide me with the transaction ID for verification.
If I pay this, will there be any more problems? I cannot lose my job or my visa.

As soon as payment is confirmed, your case will be closed and your records cleared. If you do not comply, the IRS will proceed with legal action, including freezing your bank accounts and notifying immigration authorities.
Okay, I will try to send now. How long does it take for you to confirm?
Confirmation is usually immediate. Once you have sent the funds, read the transaction number to me. If you delay more than 30 minutes, the compliance window closes and the warrant will be issued.
I am logging into Coinbase now. Please wait.
I am here. Remember, if you have any issues sending, I can guide you step by step so there are no errors.
I see the send screen. Can you repeat the wallet address for me?
Certainly, the Bitcoin wallet address is: 1KxS7w3u9zLmT5aXQYp9ErV6AbdJ8PzQrT. Please make sure you enter it exactly.
Okay, I am sending $3,600 now. It says network fee applies.
That is fine, just ensure the total sent is at least $3,600 after the fee. Once completed, read me the transaction ID to finalize your case.
